findings.observation: Quantity 'binding_energy' (-5.73 kcal/mol) carries a unit but no 'source' field; CA-DATA-001 requires every numeric entry to have non-empty unit and source. The sibling quantity 'intermolecular_distance' does carry a source ('run_020.py@c020beef', consistent with declared inputs and code_version c020beef), so the provenance omission is specific to binding_energy.

SUMMARY.md describes the counterpoise-corrected binding energy as 'a repulsive 5.73 kcal/mol', but results.json records binding_energy = -5.73 kcal/mol. A negative binding energy denotes an attractive/bound interaction, so the prose contradicts the stored value in sign/physical character (magnitudes agree at 5.73 kcal/mol). Either the prose mischaracterizes the result or the stored sign is wrong; the increment is internally contradictory.
